source: Exophase trophy list (https://www.exophase.com/game/grand-theft-auto-vi-psn/trophies/) — official names, descriptions and grades; PSNProfiles lists the same 55 names, descriptions and grades. GTA VI launched 2026-11-19, so no complete community walkthrough exists yet: every guide below is written from the official description itself, and any step that goes beyond the description is labelled as inferred, never presented as a verified fact.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.source: Exophase trophy list — official name, description and grade.
trophies.guide: The platinum. It unlocks automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned, so there is nothing to do for this one directly: follow the roadmap (story first, stranger strands as they appear, then collectibles, activities and money) and it pops last. No step here is missable on its own — the platinum only depends on the other 54. Source: Exophase trophy list (official name, description, grade).

trophies.source: Exophase trophy list — official name, description and grade.
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. This is the first story mission, so the trophy unlocks by playing the story from the start — no preparation and no detour needed. It cannot be missed: story missions unlock in order and this one is first. Source: Exophase trophy list (official name, description, grade).

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.source: Exophase trophy list — official name, description and grade.

Not missable: chapters complete in sequence and the trophy pops on completion. Source: Exophase trophy list (official name, description, grade).

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.source: Exophase trophy list — official name, description and grade.

Not missable: chapters complete in sequence. Source: Exophase trophy list (official name, description, grade).

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

Source: Exophase trophy list (official name, description, grade).

Before starting it, finish any stranger strands you still want (see Strangers & Freaks), since story content can close off after the finale — that is an inference from how story-driven games work, not a verified fact about this game. Source: Exophase trophy list (official name, description, grade).

Source: Exophase trophy list (official name, description, grade).

Source: Exophase trophy list (official name, description, grade).

trophies.source: Exophase trophy list — official name, description and grade.

This is the gold trophy that sits just under the platinum: it means finishing the story plus the side content the game's own 100% checklist counts — missions, stranger strands, collectibles and activities. Check the in-game stats/checklist screen to see what is still missing; the exact checklist is the game's own, and no outside source has published a verified full list yet. Not missable, but last-but-one: it usually pops just before the platinum. Source: Exophase trophy list (official name, description, grade).

trophies.source: Exophase trophy list — official name, description and grade.

The count is cumulative over the entire playthrough, so every stunt you pull during the story and free roam adds up; there is no need to grind them all in one session. A fast approach, inferred from the count alone: repeat short stunt jumps with a fast vehicle rather than hunting one-off set pieces. Not missable. Source: Exophase trophy list (official name, description, grade).

trophies.source: Exophase trophy list — official name, description and grade.

The game tracks 9 activity types (the starter hint and the activity trophies in this list — fishing, races, drone races, shooting range, arcade, bowling, meditation, hunting and stunt-style activities are the ones named across the list; the exact in-game roster of 9 is the game's own). Sample one of each: a fishing spot, a race, a drone race, the shooting range, an arcade machine, bowling, a meditation spot, a hunt and one more activity the game lists. Not missable — activities stay available in free roam. Source: Exophase trophy list (official name, description, grade).

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.source: Exophase trophy list — official name, description and grade.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. There are 42 challenges in total (the count PlayStation tracks for this trophy), each needing a gold-medal score. Work through them weapon by weapon, replaying any challenge that lands silver or bronze until it hits gold — challenges are repeatable, so a failed run costs nothing but time. Aim for accuracy over speed where the scoring allows it; the exact scoring thresholds are the game's own. Not missable. Source: Exophase trophy list (official name, description, grade; 42-challenge count as listed by PlayStation).

Fly each location's race and finish first; a win at a location counts once, so you need all 14, not 14 wins at one spot. Learn each course's line on a practice run, then race for the win — drone races are repeatable. Not missable. Source: Exophase trophy list (official name, description, grade; 14-location count as listed by PlayStation).

Races are repeatable, so if you lose one, just run it again. Mix vehicle types and locations as you explore; the count builds up naturally over a full playthrough. Not missable. Source: Exophase trophy list (official name, description, grade).

The partner requirement is the hard part: do this during a mission or free-roam stretch where your partner is actually with you, not after the story when they may no longer be around — that timing risk is an inference, not a verified fact. To lose the heat, break line of sight and stay out of the search area until the stars clear. Potentially missable because of the partner requirement. Source: Exophase trophy list (official name, description, grade).

Pick three shops close together, rob each in turn, and stay wanted the whole time (fleeing the cops entirely would break the chain, while getting busted would too — the description's own condition). Potentially missable because of the partner requirement: do it while partner missions are still running. Source: Exophase trophy list (official name, description, grade).

Traffic, parking lots, docks and airports are the richest hunting grounds (an inference from the open-world design). Not missable. Source: Exophase trophy list (official name, description, grade).

trophies.source: Exophase trophy list — official name, description and grade.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the game's slow-motion aiming mode (the name is the game's own): trigger it during a firefight with at least 5 enemies present and drop all 5 before the effect ends. Pick a fight with a group — a gang shootout or a wanted-level standoff — rather than a lone enemy, and make every shot count. Retryable: if you only get 4, just trigger Combat Focus again in the next fight. Not missable. Source: Exophase trophy list (official name, description, grade).

The practical reading, inferred from the wording: find a Rhino, get in it and use it, and the trophy should pop; if it does not, surviving an encounter with Rhinos is the other reading. Not missable: tanks and military encounters recur in free roam. Source: Exophase trophy list (official name, description, grade).

trophies.source: Exophase trophy list — official name, description and grade.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by — knock someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. Drive slowly past a pedestrian, swing a melee weapon from the vehicle, and connect: the name is a bowling pun (ten pin), so the target is one person bowled over, not a group. Retryable as many times as needed. Not missable: it can be done anywhere in free roam. Source: Exophase trophy list (official name, description, grade).

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.source: Exophase trophy list — official name, description and grade.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills are dirty cash you pick up from robberies and heists; launder them through your contacts to turn them into clean money, and the trophy pops when $250,000 of laundered earnings is reached. The count is cumulative, so launder every batch of marked bills you earn instead of sitting on them. Not missable: contacts and laundering stay available in free roam. Source: Exophase trophy list (official name, description, grade).

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.source: Exophase trophy list — official name, description and grade.
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — clothing, weapons, food, vehicles, anything sold in a shop counts toward the cumulative total. The count is cumulative across the whole playthrough, so normal spending on gear, ammo and outfits adds up; if you are short near the end, buy and sell high-value items to push the total over. Not missable: shops stay open in free roam. Source: Exophase trophy list (official name, description, grade).

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.source: Exophase trophy list — official name, description and grade.
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — 8 in total (the count PlayStation tracks for this trophy). Garages are buyable properties around Leonida; buy each one as you earn the money, and the trophy pops on the eighth. Garages also store your vehicles, so they are worth buying early for practical reasons, not just the trophy. Not missable: properties stay for sale in free roam. Source: Exophase trophy list (official name, description, grade; 8-property count as listed by PlayStation).

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.source: Exophase trophy list — official name, description and grade.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Scooter Bros is the in-game vehicle app (the name is the game's own): open it, register vehicles you own or find, and repeat until 10 are registered. The count is cumulative and needs 10 different registrations. Not missable: the app stays available in free roam. Source: Exophase trophy list (official name, description, grade).

roadmap.title: Story first — Chapters 1–4
roadmap.trophies: Just Like Paradise, Paradise Lost, T**s Ass Drug Money, Vice City, Baby!, Top Of The World, Ma, Trust, Break the Bank, Family Matters, DWNFALL, Hi-Jacked, Snow Storm
roadmap.note: Play the story in order. Chapter and mission trophies pop automatically on completion — nothing extra to do.

roadmap.title: Stranger strands as they appear
roadmap.trophies: Road to Rehabilitation, This Was No Boat Accident, The Lone Rider, Supply & Demand, Spin On This!, Strangers & Freaks, Fair Game
roadmap.note: Potentially missable: stranger strands may close as the story advances. Finish each strand when it appears, before the final mission.

roadmap.title: Partner & one-off moments
roadmap.trophies: Hot Together, Retail Therapy, Catch Me If You Can, In The Beginning…, Capital Offense, The Truth Is Out There, Baited My Tackle
roadmap.note: Potentially missable: these need a partner beside you or name one specific event. Do them the first time the chance appears.

roadmap.title: Activities & challenges
roadmap.trophies: Cunning Stunts, Master of None, The Shootist, Top Fun, Earn Cash, Not Kudos, Stick Fiddler, One Last Thing, Let’s Go Bowling, Ten Pin, Positive Mental Attitude
roadmap.note: Grindable in free roam: 250 stunts, 42 shooting-range golds, 14 drone-race wins, 20 race wins, 50 challenges, 18 meditation spots.

roadmap.title: Collectibles & exploration
roadmap.trophies: Don't Touch My Deck, You WAiNKer!, Whip It Good, The Goodtime State, Pest Control
roadmap.note: 3 card sets, WAiNK at 100 spots, 100 vehicles, all 52 areas, one illegal operation per gang (9 gangs). All available in free roam.

roadmap.title: Crime & money cleanup
roadmap.trophies: Gunslinger, Sneakthief, Maximum Withdrawal, A Classic Blitz Play, Dime on the Dollar, Treat Yo Self, Little Boxes, On the Spot
roadmap.note: 5 bank vaults, 1 armored truck, $250,000 laundered, $100,000 spent, 8 garages, 10 Scooter Bros registrations. Then the finale, 100% completion and the platinum.

roadmap.title: Finale & platinum
roadmap.trophies: You Gotta Know When to Get Off, A Long Road, Vice Got a Price!
roadmap.note: Finish the final mission (gold), reach 100% completion (gold), and the platinum pops last.
